1514445.initial:
1) On the Users > Settings page, select RADIUS/LDAP as authentication method.
  2) Move the mouse over the balloon icon in "VPN Access" column for All RADIUS Users/All LDAP Users on the Users > Local Users page and make sure that a pop-up tip shows "No Entries".
  3) On the Users > Local Groups page, click the Edit icon next to the "Limited Administrators" group.
  4) In the Edit Group dialog, Go to the Members tab and select "All RADIUS Users"/"All LDAP Users" in the "Non-member Users and Groups" pane. Click on the "->" button.
  5) In the VPN Access tab, select "Firewalled Subnets" in the "Networks" pane and click on the "->" button.
  6) Click the OK button.
  7) Move the mouse over the balloon icon in "VPN Access" column for All RADIUS Users/All LDAP Users on the Users > Local Users page.
1514445.title: Adding VPN Access objects for All RADIUS Users/All LDAP Users.
